verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is not itself an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents only end-user mobile features: passwordless sign-in, OTP codes, backup and passkeys. Probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec, and nothing shows an MCP server or any agent-facing interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
